verdict.rationale: Bento's marketing says every release is scored against production history offline and in CI, which covers the offline-evaluation half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents curating, selecting, or managing datasets from traces. The nearest features (issues grouping runs, signal backfills, clusters) are triage tools, not dataset curation, and shadow-mode scoring is online rather than offline. Missing for 10: an explicit dataset curation/creation workflow from production traces, documentation of how offline evals are configured and run against a curated set, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them

citations.quote: Every release scored against your production history — offline, in CI, and on live traffic.
